title: The windmill
line: Discovered checks one after another, taking a piece each time.

steps.text: Torre against Lasker, Moscow 1925: White can give up the queen to set up a windmill of rook and bishop against the king.
Offer the queen: bring the bishop to f6, where it attacks the pawn in front of the king and lines up with your rook.
steps.hint: The bishop and the rook together aim at the pawn in front of the black king.
steps.after: Black takes the queen. Now the windmill turns.

steps.text: Start the windmill: take the pawn in front of the king, with check.
steps.after: The rook is guarded by the bishop, and it blocks the bishop's line to the king.

steps.text: Move the rook along the row and take a pawn. The bishop then gives check.
steps.after: Discovered check. The king must move again.
The windmill turns: back and forth, check after check.

steps.text: Now take the bishop farther along the row, with discovered check.
Now leave the row along the file, still with discovered check, toward the queen.
steps.hint: The rook goes down its own file.

steps.after: White has taken back the queen, two pawns and a bishop.

summary: A rook and a bishop take turns: each rook move uncovers check, and the rook takes something every other move.
